---
title: "Limitations"
subtitle: "Known gaps and open engineering items"
---

# Current limitations

| Area | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Class imbalance | Not yet handled (no weighted / focal loss) |
| Checkpoint resumption | Not implemented for raw / TRL loops |
| Condensed shorthand | POC converter passes raw HF text; compression hook is a stub |
| Dual separators | Package uses last-comma; legacy converter uses `" => "` |
| Evaluation suite | Loss-centric; limited action-type metrics / confusion matrices |
| Deployment of models | Site documents the pipeline; trained weights are not shipped in git |

# Open items

1. **Weighted loss or resampling** for rare actions (RAISE / BET variants).
2. **Checkpoint resume** + best-model selection by validation loss.
3. **Finalize compressed notation** in `scripts/convert_poker_dataset.py`’s
   `compress()` hook so tokenizer and masking share one token-efficient format.
4. **Richer eval** — per-action accuracy, legality checks, stack-aware sizing
   error.
5. **Data versioning** — pin HF dataset revision hashes in config.

# Operational notes

- Large files (data, models, tokenizer) are excluded from git and must be
  regenerated.
- CUDA is strongly recommended for GPT-2 training speed.
- Adjust batch size and learning rate for your hardware.
- Always retrain the tokenizer after changing special tokens, then rerun
  downstream training.
